lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Plate A to strip B fold, about 88 deg, across the 8.5 mm neck between two relief notches. Sections at 25/50/75% (full mesh) put the line on the outer-skin apex (offset 0.00-0.04 mm). Extra sections at -1 mm and +9 mm (and -3 / +11 mm) show the two plates separated by the slot with no fold, so the fold runs only about -0.5..8.3 mm and the 0..8.4 mm line covers about 95% of it. Parallel.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Strip B to end tab fold, about 89 deg, across the full width of about 11 mm. The station scan finds the apex within 0.01-0.1 mm from t=0 to 11.0 mm, and sections at 25/50/75% show the dot on the outer skin. The hole collar beside it is not a bend. Parallel, full extent.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Tab to hook lip, about 83 deg the opposite way (Z profile), a real formed fold. Sections at 25/50/75% put the dot on the outer apex (offset 0.01-0.06 mm). The fold runs about -0.3..4.1 mm along the axis (lip about 4.4 mm wide), so the 3.7 mm line covers about 84%, which is at least 80%. Parallel.
